name: How long does a shower or tub upgrade take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a shower or tub upgrade take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower or tub upgrade depends on the complexity of the project. A straightforward replacement or conversion might take 3-7 days. More extensive renovations involving significant layout changes, custom tiling, or specialized features could extend to 2-3 weeks or more. We'll provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A simple upgrade can take 3-7 days, while more complex renovations might take 2-3 weeks or longer.
